@graph.description: Project S.P.H.E.R.E. is a staged experimental research program operated by SPHERE Research, LLC designed to subject unconventional or source-inspired hypotheses to conventional scientific measurement, metrology, uncertainty analysis, adversarial controls, preregistration, reproducible analysis, fresh confirmation, and independent replication. Pre-results; no measurements have been collected.

@graph.description: Staged experimental research program testing Protocol LOC-1 (a theory-neutral differential mechanical-resonance experiment on thin-walled hollow copper spheres) and proposed independent track ANT-B-01 under conventional metrology, GUM uncertainty analysis, blinding, and replication. Proposal and readiness stage; no results reported.
